title: A Gentle Breeze in East Nashville…
description:
Freshly Renovated top to bottom with your total enjoyment and relaxation in mind. Gather with friends and family around the Fire-Pit, sooth the time away in the Hot-Tub Cabin, watch the clouds roll by as you swing in the bamboo garden. We include the Firewood, EV charger, Wine Glasses, no extra fees. Walk down to Ugly Mugs coffee, 5 Daughters Bakery, Jeni’s Splendid Ice cream, Rose Pepper, Samurai Sushi, Boutique shops. 
3 minutes drive to beautiful Shelby Park. 
7 minute drive to Broadway.
